fields.description: Villas and townhouses in Seville, Bloom Living’s lakeside phase, with Mediterranean-inspired façades and landscaped streets.

overview: Seville combines two- and three-bedroom townhouses with three- to six-bedroom villas. Its launch also announced seven-bedroom mansions; corresponding plans were not verified.
research.locationNote: Bloom Living, Zayed City, Abu Dhabi.
research.priceNote: Bloom’s five-bedroom page advertises AED 6.5 million; this is not a guide for every home. The 2024 launch started at AED 1.8 million. Confirm current availability.
research.paymentNote: The current five-bedroom page shows 25% booking, 25% construction and 50% handover. This is an advertised structure; a dated unit-specific calendar was not verified.
research.handoverNote: Bloom’s September 2026 update reports over 64% progress and targets Q1 2027. This is a dated developer snapshot, not a completion certificate.
